t: Participate in killing Slag the Stonefoot and report back to the Cunning Family.

The mountainfolk that inhabit the Foothills of Arov have been giving us a lot of trouble. If we want to make this land our own we need to put an end to their atrocities.
There's a dangerous and vicious fighter in their tribe that we have yet to defeat. If we succeed, we believe their raids will stop. Strength is the only thing that those savages respect. We have to show them what we're made of!
Unfortunately, our hands are full with the ice monster attacks and just staying alive. So many of our allies are still frozen from the last attack! That's why we're asking you. However, we don't expect you to do it alone! Oh no! You'll need a good, strong team to take this savage down. Good luck!
Only a joint effort will help you overcome this enemy. It's time to acquire friends and learn to work in a team.
So, it's been done. Do we feel sorry about his death? Yes. Will we hesitate to give another order such as this? No.
Search among the ice for any treasure.

Oh ho, what's this?!
Maybe if we chip through this ice we'll be able to find something truly incredible!
This is the treasure! I wonder who buried this chest so far out in these frigid wastes. Let's just hope that it contains something valuable and not some useless old trinkets!
Find the hidden treasure to the north and report your success to Eric the Red.

Rumor has it that there's a real treasure hidden somewhere among the northern allods. I have no idea who would have put it there, or even who started this rumor, but it just has to be true! I mean, this place is so mysterious, something like that is totally possible!
It's too cold out there for us to go searching, but you look like you could brave the elements! And of course, all of those nasty creatures lurking among the snow.
You should go and see if you can find it. And if you do, come back and tell us about it! We have a bet going with one of the other families about whether it really exists!
The cold and freezing wind is what stopped me from finding that treasure myself! Well, that and the elementals, of course...
Aha, so you found it! I knew it had to be out there!

Kill 5 enemies of the Gibberlings (any of them will do): Harpies, Glacier and Hailstone Elementals, Werebears, Mountainfolk Shamans and Warriors. Report back to the Cunning Family in the Quiet Harbor.

We suffer from everything here, from elementals, from the mountain people, from the bear people... they all plague us. We really need to exert our dominance on this allod! A parade will be thrown for every enemy of the Gibberlings that you kill!
Excellent! You really are a great help!
Bring 5 Rare Light Blankets to Geoffroi de Desirae.

Tenebra wasn't always like this - it used to be bright and cheerful. You can probably imagine what it was like to suddenly have things change like this. Our people need warm light blankets to shield us from the cold darkness. That's right, fashionable light blankets.
There's got to be some way for you to get us some, right? You look pretty talented. I'm sure you can make us some in no time! If not, go check the Novograd Auction House.
Blankets are good for starters. At the moment, we've just started to supply Nezebgrad with the masterpieces of the Elven literature.
Wonderful! These feel great and look good too!
Kill Adrian Valir and report back to the Keen Family.

Hey! We're in on this too! Veleslav told us all about your heroic deeds for the sake of the Great Tree's seeds. Now we're busy running back and forth between the Settlement and Lukomorie, keeping the druid and the Keeper in touch. We've recently got some good news! The Great Tree has given us an answer!
We'll have a new home soon! The piece of land that the League allotted to us is harsh and inhospitable, but we'll change that. If we satisfy the last of the Great Tree's conditions, it'll grant us some seeds and Frozen Frontier will turn into a blooming garden. That's great, isn't it?
Now let's talk business. For some reason, the Keeper of the Tree is concerned about the Valir family. The last duke of that great house, Adrian, was cursed and became the "Prince of the Undead". The Great Tree wants him to finally rest in peace.
He says that if we kill the duke we'll save his soul. Please go to Castle Blight, find Adrian, and grant him eternal rest. So, will you help us? Just one more time, pretty please!
The Gibberlings won't be able manage without the help of a Great Tree. We must do as the Keeper of the Great Tree wishes!

Hurray! On behalf of Gibberlings everywhere, please accept our thanks. Adrian has found rest and that means that the Great Tree's bidding is done, and we will receive the seeds of life!
We'll go to the Keeper for the seeds right away, and then we'll take them to Frozen Frontier. Froddy the Fidget has been waiting for them!
Oh yeah, we almost forgot! Froddy asked us to reward you for your help. Oh yeah, and we also had to tell you something important... Shoot, we totally forgot! Oh well, don't fret, I'm sure it was something minor. You know - "thank you, the Gibberlings are now happy," that kind of thing...
Alright, we're out of here. So much to do, so many places to see... Good luck to you, friend of all Gibberlings!
Find the Family Tree for the House of Valir and bring it to Dobrinya Nikitov in the Settlement.

The White Knight can cause us a lot of trouble even after he's dead. The rebels will want to turn him into a martyr, and the revolt will blaze up anew.
There is only one way to prevent all this. In the Castle of the House of Valir, there is a scroll with their family tree. You've got to go in there and find it.
We must prove that the late White Knight had no claim to the throne.
Be careful - we don't call it the Castle Blight for nothing! The place is extremely dangerous.
We must expose that impostor at all costs! It's the only way to stop the unrest.

Just as I thought - the White Knight had no claim to the throne. Look at what Prince Adrian carved with his own hand under the name of his daughter Svetlana -"The last of the House of Valir." What a house!
Everything, including Kania, is changing.
Now we just need to convince the Kanian rebels of the same. But the good thing is that we've taken the sting out of them - let them try to bite now. Not a chance!
I want to reward you for this accomplishment. On behalf of the League Defenders and all Kanians, please accept our profound gratitude!
What would we ever do without you?

All's well that ends well. I am with Svetlana and Tep's plans have been crippled. Soon I will rejoin my house and I won't be alone - I'll have my wife with me!
And the House of Valir will not wither away! Old Kania blood will blend with the old blood of Elves, and we will enter the future together, renewed. A future with no enmity between the League races. Amen!
I ask you to return to Novograd and meet with Aidenus. The Great Mage helped me investigate the affair with of House de Doucer and he will certainly want to learn how this story has ended. Tell him everything.
Your courage and bravery will serve the League many more times. There's so much out there to do!

So, another chapter in the League's history book is complete. And you helped write it, but it's a shame the ink is so bloody...
O tempora, o mores!
No, I don't blame you. What was done was done right. It's just my old age showing through...
Please accept this reward. You've earned it, fair and square!
Here, take this. You won't survive without it.
Meet with Marguerite de Desirae at Summer Manor.

We need advice - the advice of those that accept Light and the dark equally, the advice of those competent in magic, the advice of those who were connected to the events surrounding the Valir castle twenty years before it became Castle Blight.
I'm talking about the Elves of the House de Desirae. It is well known that the old duke was friends with Elves from that house and that his daughter, Svetlana, was in love with one of the de Desirae princes.
After the tragic death of his daughter, the old duke went to none other than de Desiraes. I was really young at the time and very much into magic. I remember how the Elves came to the Settlement... I followed them like a puppy, listening in on their conversations and trying to feel like I was a part of their world.
Please go to the allod of Tenebra. It's a small Elven allod not far from here. Marguerite de Desirae is in charge there. Tell her everything and perhaps she will help. You can get to Tenebra by using the ancient June ruins near the Great Tree in the Lukomorie.

Don't kneel! This is no time for pomp and ceremony - only a shadow remains of the former glory of the House de Desirae...
We were thrown out of our home like pathetic weaklings! A home that was wonderful and grand, the offspring of the architectural genius of our allies, the House de Ardeur!
Damnit! I am furious. The humiliation, the shame... We must make the enemy pay! We will avenge every drop of de Desirae blood they consume.
But it looks like you're not very interested in that... What brings you to Tenebra? The Valir castle... It's interesting that the story has surfaced at a time when the very same darkness has enveloped our allod. Is there a connection? Possibly... Nothing surprises me anymore.
Meet Christophe de Desirae on the allod of Tenebra.

This is a letter from Pierre de Ardeur who heads the Elven Embassy in Novograd. He has reviewed our report on the case of Raoul de Doucer, the sculptor.
He requests that you meet with Christophe de Desirae at once to give him this letter. Christophe is the lead strategist of the House de Desirae. He's currently on the Tenebra allod. You get there if you use your Adventurer's Stone.
Farewell!

A letter from Pierre? Hm, news of more trouble... All sorts of problems have started here lately. The Galleon, built for us by the de Ardeur architects, was attacked during the night by some strange creatures. We had to flee here, to Summer Manor. We've lost everything!
Wait, let me gather my thoughts. What was your mission? Oh, yes, the sculptor from the rebellious House de Doucer... What did you find out?
You witnessed a ritual that created an Astral creature, and Raoul participated in it?! Wow! That's very interesting! We were attacked by strange Astral creatures - maybe they're related.
They are similar to spiders, bats, and rats in appearance but they have different abilities. We call them mutants at the moment, for want of a better name. They are very dangerous, so be careful when roaming this allod!
Well, it's clear that there is a link between our troubles and the events in Darkwater... Don't go anywhere, I'm going to need your help if we're to fix this mess.
Go to Tenebra and meet with Geoffroi de Desirae.

What a great invention this Adventurer's Stone is! And trust me, I've seen all sorts of magical items. Especially when it comes to Astral travel, portals, and the like. But this Stone is one the best things I've seen.
You can use these ruins here to get directly from Darkwater to Tenebra, the residence of the ruling Elven House de Desirae. You can even go visit their leaders if you want.
That reminds me, I heard that Geoffroi de Desirae, the guardian of this great house, was looking for an assistant. The Great Ball is coming up soon, so I'm sure he has plenty of things to get done.

The Great Ball? What are you talking about?! We've got enough to worry about here! I've got no time for parties!
Then again, I shouldn't panic. That's not very Elf-like behavior... So, welcome to Tenebra!
Used the Charged Astral Energy Cell to light 4 Elven Lanterns and return to Geoffroi de Desirae.

Welcome to Tenebra - the residence of the ruling Elven House de Desirae! I am Geoffroi de Desirae, one of the head guards. For many years this small allod was a harbor of peace and prosperity for all Elves wishing to leave the main Kanian allod. Now, all that has changed...
The Elves built a galleon that was a magnificent structure designed by our allies from the House de Ardeur. Recently, our beautiful building was captured and we were forced to flee. I'm ashamed to admit that we still don't know what kind of enemies oppose us.
I sincerely hope that you can help us. Recently our allod has become filled with bizarre creatures of the darkness. If you stay in the darkness for too long, you run the risk of being attacked by one of those hideous creatures.
That's why the lanterns must be lit at all times - the order comes from Marguerite de Desirae herself! "As long as the Light is with us, we shall survive," she said.
Please take this charged Astral energy cell. Use it to light four lanterns around Summer Manor. Don't think of it as your duty, think of it as an opportunity to help us out in a difficult situation. Who knows, tomorrow we may be able to help you...
The darkness thickens and our hopes wane with every passing moment...

Thank you, that's enough. The spawns of darkness won't dare come near while there is light. Keep the cell, you may need it later. There are lanterns all over the allod and lighting them will help you and others to feel safe.
Deliver the invitations to the 5 Council Members of the House de Desirae.

The story of the Castle Blight is a secret of the House de Desirae, and I cannot speak about it to you until I consult with the others. My heart tells me that the time has come to reveal this sad story, but that requires the will of the Council.
Deliver these invitations to the Elven Council members of our House. All of them refused to leave on the rescue ship in order to stay here and recapture what the darkness has taken from us. I am proud of my relatives.
You'll find them here, in the Estate, and on the Amber Coast to the west. Please hurry, we have much to discuss.
The faster the Council gathers, the sooner you'll get the answers to your questions.

Thank you for your help. We will now need some time to discuss everything in detail. Be patient, for the Elves do not rush decisions on important matters... The Valir castle, your Castle Blight, is a matter of great importance. You may yet see that for yourself.
Find 4 books from the archives of the House de Desirae for Augustin de Desirae at the Summer Manor.

I have seen much but rarely have I wept. Even the Great Cataclysm did not wound me as deeply as the destruction of the House de Desiraes' library!

So many unique books, priceless documents, and brilliant paintings... So much was destroyed! I watched as dark creatures tore Pascal's Revelations to shreds. Gargoyles defiled the gorgeous marble face of Zayan's statue! I was powerless to stop them! I was running around the library, mad with grief, trying to save a fraction of the wisdom and beauty entrusted to me for safekeeping. Oh great Astral, save me from suffering that again...!

I was able to save something, however. The owls, my loyal servants, also saved a few things. The clever creatures grabbed books and documents and flew out of the windows! Unfortunately, not all my owls returned to the Summer Manor. Many of them may have been killed by the twilight creatures. The scouts have found one of the Elven masterpieces scattered around the allod. It was covered in owl blood.

I beg you, find the remaining books in the forest. I believe there are nine owls unaccounted for, each of which took one masterpiece with it. My heart tells me that the books are lying in the grass of nearby forests. But they should be here where I can keep an eye on them.
Oh, what times we live in! Things that took centuries to create have been turned into dust in seconds!

I don't know how to thank you. These books are only a small part of our great collection, but it's better to save a fragment than to lose everything! Please let me be right now, I must care for these books and mourn my loyal friends, the wise owls...
Kill 4 Cursed or Tainted Rats around the Summer Manor. Report back to Patricia de Desirae.

I spent many years painting the Galleon, decorating that exquisite combination of magic and technology! Unfortunately, their part in building the magnificent ship guarantees the House de Ardeur success during the next Great Game. But let them enjoy it, for we, the de Desirae, get to control it in return!
Well, that was the plan, but now all that beauty belongs to the darkness. Evil Elves have seized control of it and renamed it Darkblood Citadel.
I am sure we'll get the Galleon back eventually, but it won't happen by itself. We must... paint the future with our actions!
The mutants who have been attacking us didn't appear out of nowhere - they are the same rats, gargoyles, and spiders that have lived here for centuries. They are nothing but the enemies' twisted weapons and we must disarm them!
There are many rats around here that have not yet been infected by the darkness. They're normal now, but tomorrow they could fall under evil influences and attack us, just like the Elves from the Galleon. We must deprive them of the opportunity and make sure it doesn't happen. So, can you kill off a few of those rats?

I only have one color of paint now - red. And you are the brush that paints the future. A good future.
How is that painting entitled "All Rats Are Dead" coming along?

Excellent! We're now safe from the rats now and it's time to proceed to our next painting -"Getting the Galleon Back." I don't want to change the color of the paint just yet - let it be red once more.
Eliminate 4 Twilight Gargoyles on the Amber Coast. Report to Christophe de Desirae at the Summer Manor.

Those creatures threaten us all. The amber they collect is intended for some evil purpose!

Kill at least four Twilight Gargoyles. Even if it doesn't stop them, at least it'll distract them for a while.

A good job merits a reward. Take these clothes, they'll come in handy later.
However, we must not rest on our laurels. We must find out where these mutants are coming from! My scouts are already working on this and I hope to get news from them soon.
Collect 4 lights from the Will-o'-the-Wisps with the Deluminator and use it to charge the Necromancer's Lantern. Report back to Patric de Desirae.

While the others panicked and counted their losses, those of us in our right minds got to work.
The House de Desirae became famous for its necromancy and that is exactly what will help us in this hour of need. Will-o'-the-wisps live in the forest to the east of here. In case you're not familiar with them, they're magical creatures - fragments of the souls of dead Elves, people... and others.
The power from these beings is often used in necromancy, and that's exactly the resource I intend to use now. I'm sure that the fragments of departed souls will be better sources of energy for our lanterns than Astral energy cells.
Help me to kill a few will-o'-the-wisps and collect their energy by using this trap I'll give you. Once it's full, try using it to light the lantern right next to me! We'll see what the darkness thinks about a flaming soul!
We must fight fire with fire! Everything that's happening here is caused by magic and only magic can save us from the forces of darkness!

What a silly mistake! I have a way to go before I reach Prince Dakkar's level... Who is Dakkar?! The Prince was the best necromancer in history until his disappearance!
We must get back to the matters at hand, however. Bats are flocking to the wandering lights like moths! That's not quite what I expected but on the other hand, that indicates that their nature is also related to necromancy. Interesting...
Deliver the bust of Prince Dakkar to Augustin de Desirae.

There is a marble bust inside the Elven chest. The inscription on the base reads "Prince Dakkar de Desirae." It must be one of the lost Elven relics.

The poor soul is missing his nose but the librarian will be delighted to see him anyway!
I am going to draw up a catalogue of the items you saved. I hope they'll be safe at Summer Manor. Have you managed to find anything?

I'm planning to make a list of items we've saved. I hope they'll be safe in the Manor. You have a mysterious look about you... Did you manage to find something new?
Oh my! This bust once stood in one of our drawing rooms. Wonderful work, it's a depiction of Dakkar de Desirae, the most powerful necromancer of our House. He disappeared twenty years ago in the Valir castle... It was a tragic loss for all of us! I'm sure that if the Prince was still with us, the darkness wouldn't have dared to invade our allod.
It's interesting that his bust survived, I'd say there's something symbolic about that!
Take the Diary of Vamp de Desirae to Marguerite de Desirae in Summer Manor.

The diary of Vamp de Desirae, what an interesting read... The diary tells the story of Vamp meeting an Elf who later attacked and bit him. After that, Vamp began suffering from strange symptoms - a fear of light, constant thirst for blood, aggressive drive and growing fangs...
This document must be taken to Marguerite de Desirae at once! She must see this! This could explain a lot of the strange behavior that's been happening in Tenebra lately.

What's this? Hm... Interesting... The twilight creatures who attacked us behaved just like the diary describes. They sought our blood! Can it really be that these sentient beings act just like animals?
Poor Vamp! He paid for this discovery with his blood! That is another matter for the consideration of the Council. I wonder who that Elf was... the one that bit my counselor?
Deliver the Astral Clump to Romain de Ardeur.
This substance looks to be Astral in nature. The House de Ardeur studies the Astral, so the architect must know what this is! Show him your discovery.

Life here is full of danger now. But as one of the creators of the Palace I am primarily interested in what caused the darkness to appear.
This fell out of a mutant? What an interesting substance... It must be studied carefully. Thank you for this find, it could turn out to be extremely important!
Check the communication beacons and return to Romain de Ardeur.

After the darkness descended upon us the Elves of the House de Ardeur took refuge in the Tainted Woods. We had no problems communicating with the de Ardeurs until recently...
The fact that our communications have been interrupted worries me greatly. Please take the June ruins and check the communication beacons.
Go from beacon to beacon and you'll eventually end up at their camp. Once you get the job done, go see the head of the House de Ardeur. Good luck!

I welcome you to our little camp! After the Great Cataclysm, this forest was used as a haven by the Elves of the House de Desirae, and now we have found a home here too! Did you manage to find the problem with the beacons?

Thank you so much for your help. How do you like the Galleon we've built? A sad sight, wouldn't you say? We are calling it Darkblood Citadel... and to think that it was once the most beautiful building in the universe, of which the House de Ardeur was rightly proud!
Our architects could not have made a mistake. This was sabotage and we will find those who are responsible and make them pay sooner or later!
Kill 4 Twilight Cobras, Twilight Rats or Twilight Tarantulas. Report back to Vivien de Ardeur in the Tainted Woods.

Oh, thank Tensess! Here's someone who'll listen! There's nothing more depressing than a failure to act! While we Elves tried to work out what caused the darkness to appear, while we concocted elaborate theories and pretended to be intelligent, the spawn of the darkness took our beautiful allod from us!
We cannot sit around doing nothing while mutants roam our lands! They must all be destroyed immediately! Help me in this noble quest. You'll find mutant cobras near our settlement, mutant rats at Lamia Lake, and mutant spiders in Spider Thicket. Show them no mercy!
Some call me mad, but I swear I know more than any of these Elves! The spawns of darkness must be destroyed!

I'm glad you're on my side. My cousin Romain wants to study the mutants while another cousin, Alphonse, is busy studying lamias. But why would anyone waste their time with lamias? If I could convince them to side with me, we could get rid of the darkness once and for all...
Bless the jar of water at the altar in the Chapel of Tensess.

You are just in time, I require a reliable and useful assistant. The Church of Light draws its strength from loyal servants of the ideals of Light, like you!
Anyway, let's get down to business! I am looking for a more effective weapon against the creatures of the darkness that have captured our land and chased us from our wonderful home. The first thing that comes to mind is holy water! The powers of Light and the Holy Tensess against the creatures of the darkness is bound to work.
However, our Chapel of Tensess has fallen under the darkness and getting to it is not as easy as it once was. Take this jar of water and bless it at the Chapel altar. Beware the of bats and may the Light be with you!
The power of the Holy Tensess shall help us overcome the forces of darkness! Did you bless the water?
The times are truly terrible if Chapel of Tensess has become home to mangy bats. Nonetheless, I believe we will be victorious! What we need to do now is try out this holy water!
Take the coat of arms to Augustin de Desirae.

Judging by the ornate pattern and the motto "Learning is greater than death, and beauty is greater than learning," this is the coat of arms of the ruling house and will be of special significance to the de Desirae family.

The librarian will be happy to add it to his collection of relics.
Not long ago I dreamt that I was back in my library... There was no explosion and the books and scrolls were safely on their shelves... Oh, what a wonderful dream it was!

Yes, this is the ruling house's coat of arms. The de Desirae family received it twenty years ago during that year's Great Ball. Eight houses competed in art and magic but Prince Dakkar, our genius necromancer, managed to outshine them all. It seemed that there was no barrier to his knowledge and death was turned to art in his hands... Soon after the Great Ball something terrible happened and the Prince disappeared without a trace.
Let me wipe the dust and dirt off our coat of arms.
Kill the creatures of darkness by using the holy water, the lamia weapon, and the wooden stake. Inform Frederic de Ardeur of the outcome.

It's time to test the weapons. We need to find out which of the three is more effective against the spawn of darkness.
Let's do this - there is a lantern next to it that guards against darkness. So go to the chapel and extinguish the lantern. Hopefully by doing that, some sort of Astral mutant will appear and you must fight him using the water, the silver lamia weapon, and the wooden stake. It might be a bat, a rat, or maybe even one of the fallen Elves, the "vampires", will grace you with their presence. But whatever it is isn't important.
What matters is finding a weapon against to use against the darkness. I shall pray for you, Oh Warrior of Tensess!
Holy Tensess, you see that the darkness has enveloped our allod and we are confused. Send us a sign... Who's there? I was expecting a sign and got you instead! Did you test the weapons?

I'm surprised... Though, I shouldn't have doubted the wooden stakes. They may be primitive but they're certainly effective. Oh, Tensess, have mercy on your poor servant and guide him to the path of righteousness!
So, we'll use the stakes to fight the spawn of darkness, be they snakes, spiders, or Elves!
Inform Christophe de Desirae that a weapon for fighting vampires has been found.

The Elves of the House de Desirae must be informed about a weapon being found. I would rather not inform them via the communication beacons seeing as they are so close to the Darkblood Citadel.
Go see Christophe de Desirae personally and tell him that we finally found an effective weapon to fight against the vampires!
A piece of wood... Who would have thought?

Wooden stakes? It's hard to believe...
But then again - I have no reason to not trust you or Frederic. The good thing about this weapon is that it can be made very quickly and in large quantities. I think eliminating mutants and vampires should only be a matter of time now.
You deserve a reward for bringing such good news!
Accuse Vivien de Ardeur of treason.

The letter found on the vampire's body reads:
"Vivien, you are wrong to avoid me. My feelings for you have not changed. In your last letter you say that I betrayed and used you, Astral forbid... How could you possibly say that?! If I am at fault for our disagreement, then my only mistake is not to have told you the full details of my plan. I simply didn't want to scare you! I can tell you everything now, however.
It is true that the artifact I asked you to put in the engine room was not a surveillance device. Forgive me for this lie - I was forced to deceive you in order to achieve my objective. I now posses the great and terrible power that I hinted at so many times before and I want to share it with you. I need you, Vivien! All my dreams have come true but I lack only one thing - your love. In addition, I can't seem to make any sense of your Galleon and your engineering genius will come in handy.
I'm sending you this letter with my young cousin. He has already become one of is and he'll be able to perform the initiation ritual on you as well. Don't be afraid, it only hurts a little and only lasts for a few seconds. But what follows is power, strength, and immortality. Eternal love, Vivien, is that not what we dreamed of together, you and I?
Forever yours, Armando de Doucer"
Who would have thought! Vivien hates the creatures of darkness so much... But the evidence is irrefutable - she is clearly involved in this whole story.
She must be questioned about this letter at once!
Hello. Are you still with me?! The surrounding area is crawling with mutants. It seems that they're multiplying before our very eyes. We must continue our experiments on them... What's this?

...Oh, you know everything! My life is over...
There is no point in denying it - everything that has happened is my fault! Fate drew me to Armando during a visit to Novograd. He was... Just like me... We fell in love. You probably won't understand but he could make me do whatever he wanted... When he asked me for a small favor with that damn stone I wasn't able to refuse!
I didn't know it would end in darkness! I'll never forgive myself...

characters: Junior Architect of the House de Ardeur

t: Take the request to Romain de Ardeur in Summer Manor.

After what happened, I didn't have the courage to own up! Nobody would have understood what I did!
I wanted to make amends by fighting the darkness... I curse the day I met Armando!
I beg you, please find my cousin, Romain de Ardeur, in Summer Manor. I hope that he'll forgive me and protect me! Maybe he'll think of a way of telling others about what the darkness is concealing and that the House de Doucer, with some sort of terrible and mysterious power, is behind what happened.
Oh, please don't tell anyone about this! I regret what happened tremendously... If my crime is revealed, I will be executed. Spare me and give me a chance to redeem myself...
I have been studying the substance you brought and have reached some very interesting conclusions... What?! Vivien has screwed up again?

Oh, my! Damnit! Poor Vivien... I have suspected that she... But how could she believe Armando de Doucer?! That soppy idiot!

And what am I supposed to do now? Damnit...

I can't abandon her but I can't conceal what happened from the House de Desirae either...

I must tell the story without exposing my cousin.

And I'm going to need your help to do that!
Receive your reward from Marguerite de Desirae for saving the Elven relics.

I've never had an assistant as reliable as you. If it weren't for your help, our relics would have vanished into oblivion. I've informed Marguerite of this and she is waiting to see you, so that she can give you the reward deserve.
The librarian told me about your discoveries. I am delighted that at last someone has began to work on recovering our relics!

The items and documents you returned are valuable to not only to Elves, but all of Sarnaut. They are part of the history of the world, its cultural heritage!
Take this weapon as a sign of our gratitude. You may soon need it!

We now have a fairly good idea of what happened. It is important for me, as the strategy expert of the House de Desirae, to know all the details of this crime.
Some unknown "Ally" bestowed upon Armando de Doucer some sort of knowledge that allowed him to gain power over the darkness. The price he paid for this was the need for other beings' blood. Armando became the first vampire, and he then infected the other de Doucers. Then, I'm not yet sure how, the Artifact of darkness was delivered onto the ship and this turned our home into a vampire incubator.
Part of the energy was channeled to the magic artifacts at the Boarder and caused the twilight creatures to appear. They turned our beautiful palace into their instrument of vengeance, their revenge for the power they lost at the Great Ball twenty years ago.
There's only two things that aren't clear - how the artifact turned up on the Galleon, and the identity of this mysterious "Ally." I have a hunch about the former...
But the latter... Perhaps you should talk with Marguerite de Desirae.

So, we've unraveled this mystery and all thanks to you. In gratitude, the House de Desirae has unanimously decided to share the story of the Valir castle with you. I will tell you everything we know.
Soon after our victory at the Great Ball, the daughter of Adrian Valir, a Kanian Duke, died. Thanks to Tensess' sacrifice, everyone who lives on the allods are given the hope of resurrection and eternal life. Everyone except Svetlana Valir, whose soul was stolen by magic. Priests of Tensess were unable to do anything and so the Duke turned to Dakkar de Desirae, our necromancer. Prince Dakkar loved Svetlana and began the Rescue Ritual immediately. But something terrible happened during the ritual and we're still unsure as to what. The castle was cursed, its inhabitants abandoned it, Adrian Valir turned undead, and Prince Dakkar and his beloved have been missing ever since.
Find the identity of the ally that's in league with the House de Doucer.

We don't know what is going on in the castle now. And to be honest, I am more concerned about this ally that helped the Elves of the House de Doucer. His magical talents are obvious.
I am inclined to think that this "ally" has something to do with what happened at the Valir castle. Either personally or through the late Armando, he interfered with the ritual Prince Dakkar was performing. And we all know is how it ended...
I'm asking you to find out who this ally is and I am confident that you will succeed! The only place where you can do this is in the Valir castle.
Go back to Darkwater, take your most trusted and true friends, infiltrate the castle, and unravel this mystery!
I never thought I'd see you again, especially in this terrible place!

The Rescue Ritual could not be completed. Svetlana awoke from the dead but in the form of a witch and her poor father turned into an undead ghoul. I blamed myself for everything and chose to leave this world.

However, the events on Evermeet Isle forced me to carry out my own investigation. I now know that I am not to blame for the curse on the castle. The real culprits are the House de Doucer and their ally from the Astral - Tep, the evil necromancer.

Tep didn't have a pyramid or spark vault out here and so he chose the Valir castle. With Tep's help, the necromancers of the House de Doucer sabotaged my ritual and turned the castle into a kingdom of the undead. Tep put his guardian, Mor'Ghuun, in the castle to watch over it. The monstrous creature can kill with a mere glance and I fear we'll have to face it!
Kill 4 Lamias and their leader Deianeira. Report back to Simeon de Ardeur in the Tainted Woods.

Now, let's get down to business. The House de Ardeur needs your help. Our situation is very insecure. The more the darkness deepens, the more active these twilight creatures become. However, the lamias are giving me even more cause for concern.
These creatures have always lived on Tenebra. We've never had peace with them, but we've never destroyed them either - the era of the Battle for Beauty is long past, and it's not my people's custom to kill for the sake of killing.
However, we barely managed to repel their most recent attack. If we don't show those cunning creatures our real strength, we can be certain of another invasion. Unfortunately, we don't have the ability to fight them again right now.
Please go to Lamia Lake and kill a few of them for us. While you're there make sure that you destroy their leader - Deianeira! She's an old and cunning creature. I'm sure it was she who ordered the attacks.
We have too many enemies here...
The deed is done. I hope the lamias will stop giving us trouble now - we've got enough problems as it is!
Steal a Lamia Weapon and bring it to Frederic de Ardeur.

There are lamias that live near the lake not far from here. They're evil and wanton creatures - may Tensess damn them! After their recent attack, one of our scouts followed them back to their lake. He saw them kill the mutants with incredible ease.
The only explanation for this lies in their weapons, for the holy Tensess could not have given them the power to fight the darkness instead of us.
I'm also sure that the scout's report is a sign from Tensess himself. Lamia weapons will help us defeat the darkness. I'm sure your mission is clear to you - infiltrate the lamia camp and bring me back one of their weapons!
Did you manage to get me a lamia weapon?

So that's what a lamia weapon looks like! All covered by dark patina, so threatening, so noble...
It seems that the forces of darkness are afraid of silver. I can't wait to find out how effective it is against mutants.
Find Alphonse de Ardeur near Lamia Lake.

Oh, will no one help me? My fiancé, Alphonse, has been studying those damn lamias his entire life. Now that they've attacked us, I fear for him! He could be hurt! Or worse, he may have perished...
I beg you, go to the lamia camp and find my Alphonse or whatever is left of him. I hope... no, I'm sure he's still alive, but there's nothing worse than uncertainty.

Stop! What are you doing here? You're a vandal, a barbarian, a murderer! Don't you dare harm these darling lamias. I have spent countless hours in their company and I can assure you that they're not the heartless monsters my kin believes them to be. On the contrary, lamias can be very kind and gentle...
Convey Alphonse de Ardeur's response to Isabelle de Vevre.

Isabelle sent you? Of course... I should have let her know that I'm okay and that there's no reason to worry. But In truth, I forgot all about it! I've gotten to know these creatures... very intimately, if you know what I mean.
Boy I tell you, lamias make great lovers! Elven wives don't even come close to them. They can move in ways an Elf never could!
Oh, you don't approve of that? Well, you're just another snob and bigot like the rest of my kin! I have no intention of going back to live among them! I am happy here! Please tell Isabelle that... and tell her that I'm sorry.
Did you find him? Please don't tell me Alphonse is dead! My life has no meaning without him. He loved me so dearly and our wedding was to be so joyful...

What?! That lamia loving son of a... I knew he was a little weird but I could never have imagined this! Oh the shame, I wish they had really killed him!
Listen, please don't breathe a word of this to anyone. There will be no end to my embarrassment if word gets out that he left me for lamias! Okay?
Take the Declaration on the Creation of the League to Augustin de Desirae.

The scroll is affixed with several seals, one depicting a Kanian eagle stands out above the rest. Peeling away part of the scroll reveals its title - "Declaration of the Creation of the League."

This is undoubtedly an historical document of great value. The librarian will be delighted.
I thought that our collection would be as safe as possible in this new Galleon Palace, but it turned out to be quite the opposite...

The creation of the League was a turning point in the history of Elves. The Elves had never before sought out allies, but the Great Cataclysm brought about a great change and we were forced to change with it. In the year 707 of the New Era, the Orcs and Xadaganians captured the Elven allod of Grokh and it was clear they had no intention of stopping there. At an extraordinary Great Ball it was decided to agree to an alliance with Kania and in 721 the Elves and Kanians finally signed the Declaration and created the League... A truly priceless find!
Speak to Silvio in Spider Thicket.

It would be foolish of us to refuse help at this difficult time. The Elves have always shunned nature magic, believing it to be insufficiently elegant. However, even those who did not accept the sacrifice of Tensess must have many useful secrets, or Tensess would not have blessed everyone with his gift.
There is one such creature that lives in the grove to the northeast of here. His name is Silvio and he is a wise old treant. Maybe he knows of a better weapon to fight the vampires with? In any case, you should seek his advice immediately. Hopefully he can help us in these dark times.

Oh, I thought you were another one of those creatures from the darkness. A couple of them showed up here earlier, but I was too strong for them!
It looks like the Elves really are in trouble if they're seeking the wisdom of an old, overgrown tree! The question is, should I help them?
Kill Shelba and her 4 Tarantulas. Report back to Silvio in Spider Thicket.

The darkness that came from the castle has covered all of this allod. I am old, very old... I saw the world shatter when I was a mere sprout, I saw... Hm, I don't remember now. My memory is not what it once was.
But what I can say for sure is that everything passes. This too shall pass. The darkness will retreat and then return again as it has for centuries. There are more important things to worry about. For example, Shelba, the giant spider...
She and I have been enemies for a long time now. If you help me deal with her, I might be inclined to give you advice about the creatures of the darkness.
The forest is full of rustling, there is no light, and strange creatures move in the darkness. The world is changing again and if there's one thing I hate, it's change...
Hah! Looks like old Shelba got what was coming to her! Fear not, I remember my promise and I'll keep my word.
Prepare 4 wooden stakes by breaking branches from nearby trees. Return to the camp in the Tainted Woods and relay Silvio's words to the priest Frederic de Ardeur.

Here's what I know... There were two Elves here, and they too were victims of the darkness. Or maybe they created it...
Either way, they're dead now. My branches were the weapon that killed them. Pierced through their soft flesh with ease, and their souls returned to the Astral.
That's what you need to tell the Elves - a wooden stake is the best weapon against the spawns of darkness! If anyone is in any doubt, they can test it out themselves. You can gather branches from the trees on your way back and give them to the Elves to test. Farewell, gentle one...
Oh, there you are! How is our old wooden friend? Did he tell you anything useful?

Wooden stakes? Hmm, is that not too simple a weapon? Then again, Silvio's word is one you can rely on. It's a good thing you managed to get some stakes on your way here - the sooner we can begin our experiments the better!
What Silvio said about the Elves and the darkness has been confirmed by the folks at Summer Manor. The poor souls were spotted there too. They even have a name for them over there - vampires, after their first victim, Vamp de Desirae.
Take the Court Judgment to Augustin de Desirae.

This scroll is bound with the seal of the House de Desirae. The parchment is soaked and the letters can be read through it...

"Court Judgment on the case of the House de Doucer". Another wonderful relic from the library, which should be returned to Summer Manor.
You have a mysterious look about you, did you manage to find something else by any chance? Tell me, I beg of you!

Yes, this truly is a wonderful document! 2 years ago, following his victory at the Great Ball, Prince Dakkar de Desirae staged an important ritual in the Valir castle. It ended in tragedy with the Prince disappearing and a curse being laid on the castle. We believed that it was the House de Doucer that meddled with the ritual using Astral magic and causing the disaster.
An investigation began and while the evidence was circumstantial, the reputation of the House de Doucer was left under a cloud. We have been sworn enemies ever since.
Eliminate 4 demons and cultists. Report back to Geoffroi de Desirae at the Summer Manor.

At last! I've been looking for you everywhere.
I have terrible news... Demons have appeared on our archipelago! A scouting party was spotted southeast of here on the Astral coast. They have a cultist with them and that can only mean one thing - they'll soon be joined by the Defilers and Soul Devourers. May Tensess save us!
The demons must be destroyed immediately, before their main forces arrive to help them. We can't rely on the Galleon to protect us now. Eliminate the demons and save us!
Demonic scouts are the first sign of trouble. Death, destruction, and chaos come hot on their heels. Only by destroying them can we hope to avoid the second wave of the invasion on Tenebra.

We are saved? Phew... Thank the Light!
Heh, these disasters sure have made a believer out of me. But then again, we also have you and your weapons to thank. Providence has sent us a real warrior in our hour of need.
Collect 4 Astral Ichor samples from the Twilight Gargoyles. Take them to Romain de Ardeur at the Summer Manor.

We must tell the de Desiraes everything we know. But in a way that prevents Vivien from being suspected of involvement. It's not going to be easy.

But first things first. I've studied the substance you found. it's certainly interesting and clearly of Astral origin. I have decided to call it Astral Ichor. It can accumulate magical energy, but this magic is blacker than darkness itself. It's the magic of death...

I can probably fool Marguerite by putting forward a believable theory about a certain artifact that caused this ichor to appear. But I will need samples to support my theory, and the more I have the better.

Get me another four Astral Ichor samples from the Twilight Gargoyles at the Eastern Border. I'll draft a report about the artifact and use the samples as evidence to support my conclusions.

Vivien made a terrible mistake but her remorse is genuine. I do not want the mark of dishonor to stain her good name and our House.
Did you get the ichor samples?

I'll attach these samples to the report. We will make public the reason why darkness is spreading - however, the name of the guilty party shall remain secret. Thank you for your help with this delicate matter.
Escort Guillaume de Desirae to Summer Manor and speak with Geoffroi de Desirae.

I'd almost given up hope of getting out of here alive. That Xadaganian bastard is a master of torture. I didn't even know I could take that much pain.
After darkness fell, we sent a wave of magical energy into the Astral in an attempt to dispel the darkness. The demons must have found out where the epicenter was and came to investigate. They sent their cultist lackey to interrogate me, but I had nothing to tell them...
Please, you've got to help me get out of here! I've taken some pretty grave wounds and I need to get back to town. If we make it to safety, please tell Geoffroi de Desirae about the demon invasion as soon as possible.
Hm, we're losing more scouts. I'm starting to get worried.

You saved Guillaume?! He's been missing since the darkness fell. The House de Desirae is forever in your debt. ...You say he was attacked by Astral demons? That's disturbing news indeed. I'll inform my superiors that their attacks have increased. Thank you.
Take the book of Francois de Vignon's poetry to Augustin de Desirae.

This book of poetry is a collection of the works of the great Elven poet, Francois de Vignon. This edition, published during the author's lifetime, is a real treasure.
It ought to be taken to the librarian - he's bound to be delighted.
Each new discovery warms my heart. It's like I meeting an old friend I had lost all hope of seeing again. What is it this time?

Each new discovery warms my heart. It's like I meeting an old friend I had lost all hope of seeing again. What is it this time?

 Oh my, I don't believe my eyes!

"I stand on the shore alone

The darkness is upon our home

It is midnight and the road is long

Who will miss me when I'm gone?"

Wonderful words, wouldn't you say? After the Great Cataclysm, beauty in all its manifestations became our ideal.

At the Great Ball, we decided on cultural expansion and the alliance with Kania helped our great mission of enlightenment.
Eliminate 4 Twilight Bats at the Western Border. Report to Christophe de Desirae at the Summer Manor.

I have very important news. Our scouts have finally discovered where all these twilight beasts are coming from.
The Western Border! The Border has now become home to an enormous population of twilight bats. Their wings obscure the light and their screaming can drive you crazy. No wonder my very best people were unable to make it back...
A difficult and dangerous mission awaits you. But do not avoid battle! Kill as many creatures of the darkness as you can and you will earn the eternal gratitude of House de Desirae.
These nocturnal creatures are causing too much trouble - they must be destroyed. Don't put this job off.
Splendid! The fewer of those disgusting creatures there are, the better we'll sleep at night. I hope the day we finally rid our archipelago of these wretches is nigh.
Use the magic time bombs to blow up four Vampire Stele and report to Christophe de Desirae.

Now let me get to the point. We discovered strange steles at the Western Frontier. No doubt they are connected to the darkness that has straddled Tenebra. One of the masters of House de Doucer who was lucky to come back alive from there described them thus:
"These magical steles seem to emanate darkness themselves. Anyone who comes under their influence changes literally within seconds, becoming the very twilight creatures of darkness that attacked us.
The steles are guarded by "vampires", as they are now called. Without a doubt, we are dealing with some kind of new, unknown magic and these steles are part of that magic."
So there we have it. We've decided to destroy these steles. Will you do it? I'll give you four magic bombs. These weapons are dangerous, so handle them with care. Set a bomb next to each stele, and don't even think of standing near - they could blow your head clean off!
Hmm, trouble? I know the steles are well guarded but they must be destroyed at any price!

The Nosferatu Farm is no more and that's all down to you. Here, take these clothes as your reward. However, the destruction of the Farm was but a first step. The time for decisive action has come and our enemies will be made to pay for their evil!
Take the House de Doucer Signet Ring to Marguerite de Desirae in Summer Manor.

A signet ring with the seal of the House de Doucer! This is an excellent opportunity to tell the de Desiraes that their enemies, the House de Doucer, are the cause of the darkness and keep Damien's name out of it!
This signet ring must be delivered to Marguerite de Desirae at once.

So, everything is finally clear - our ancient enemy, the House de Doucer is at fault... What scum!
Then again, if the enemy is hiding he must be vulnerable. The Elves of the House de Desirae will act immediately! It's time we recaptured the Galleon and ended the invasion of the darkness!
Take the Scout Report to Augustin de Desirae.

"The report drafted by the scouts who explored the Valir castle". Hm... The seal on the document is broken - it reads:

"Our unit was sent to the Valir castle to investigate the grim rumors that have been popping up about it. The area around the castle is deserted and no one dares to approach it. Local legend tells of the undead and a terrible monster that lives in the castle.

An external examination did not yield anything of value, however, we heard voices behind the walls and some unclear but chilling whispers. A heap of carts and abandoned items can be seen in the courtyard, just beyond the gate. There are no human remains. The place bears the mark of desertion, yet the presence of something alien can be felt very clearly. It's as if someone invisible is watching us. Two of our scouts volunteered to try to reach the Count's throne through the courtyard. It seems as though they met their end here. We waited outside for an extra two hours before deciding to head back.

Rudolph de Desirae".

This is an Elven scout report regarding the situation at the Valir castle. Another gift for the good librarian and some good insight as to what happened in the Valir castle.

The castle of the Valir family, now called Castle Blight, is one of the gloomiest places in Kania. Since the castle's curse, it has been inhabited by ghosts and the undead. They say that a terrible monster lives in the castle, a beast that can kill with a mere glance. I don't believe that nonsense, though!
Brave folk have tried to get into the Valir castle many a time. Some were after their treasure, while others were simply curious. It didn't seem to make much difference though - none of them ever returned. Our scouts seem to be no different...
Bring the Head of Armando de Doucer to Marguerite de Desirae.

So, the House de Doucer... A once great house... The decision to attack Kirah was made when the House de Doucer was in power. It was their house that had to bear the brunt of the demon attack that fateful day. Perhaps that was what broke Armando...
Armando is the head of the disgraced house. He's lived through so much and the defeat during the last Great Game must have been his last straw. I don't think he'll ever forgive Prince Dakkar for that defeat. He beat him using death magic - the very magic in which Armando considered himself to be the most skilled in.
I'm sure Armando is behind all of this. Only he has the power to wield this blinding darkness. Armando was the major suspect in what happened at the Valir castle. Unfortunately, all our efforts to find him have failed...
You will do it! Go to Darkblood Citadel and kill Armando de Doucer. No, don't just kill him - annihilate him forever, give him the gift of ultimate death. Yes, I demand Armando's head! May his damned soul never return to this world! Bury him in the past - forever!
Only the death of Armando can lift the dishonor from his house. Choose a method of execution and carry it out!
I met Armando de Doucer at the Great Ball several times. He was so sophisticated... His unbridled vanities lead his house to a sad end. Now he's dead... dead forever! Justice has triumphed!
Kill 10 Vampires living within Darkblood Citadel.

The time has come for us to pay a visit to the Darkblood Citadel. We will no longer be pushed around by their kind! We must take back our Galleon! Our architectural triumph that was painstakingly created by the House de Ardeur!
And now I am sending you to our beloved palace with an order to kill. Take out as many vampires as possible. Wooden stakes have been proven to be a good weapon, so that's all you should need to do the deed.
You failed to infiltrate Darkblood Citadel? Did you run out of stakes?

Death has released these poor souls! Even though the Elves of the House de Doucer brought endless grief upon us, I pity them nonetheless. I'm sure that it was not their will to become vampires, but Armando left them no choice.
Find the artifact in the engine room on the Galleon and take it to Romain de Ardeur.

I have provided Christophe de Desirae with the Astral ichor analysis data and informed him of the source of the magical energy in the engine room on the Galleon. Suspicion will not fall on Vivien but we must get that artifact! As long as it continues to work, there will be no end to our troubles.
Couldn't find the artifact? It must be in the engine room somewhere. Find it, quickly!

Here it is, the cause of all our troubles. Its magical power has left it and passed to the Galleon. How sad... All the time and effort that went into this palace and now all that's left for me to do is seal its doors forever or at least until we can find a way of purging it of the dark energy.
Kill 3 Vampires and brings their heads to the magic protective field that shields Emile de Ardeur.

No, no... Don't even bother trying to trick me! You're just another one of those cursed vampires! Leave, you'll never get a droplet of my blood! Oh, you want me to trust you?
Then bring three vampire heads to this door! Once you've done that, then I might believe you.
Ah ha! I knew you were one of them! I won't open the door until three Vampires lose their heads.

So you're not a vampire after all! My name is Emile de Ardeur and I was the chief mechanic until the explosion happened.
I was sent a vision and learned the truth! Everything that's happened here is punishment for our Elven pride. Our necromancers wanted to defeat death itself and our builders experimented with the Astral...
The Elves have angered the mighty Tensess and they must repent. To make up for our sins we have founded a new church here, the Church of the End of Time. I am its leader, and I am committed to setting things right.
Defeat the Twilight Shadow and speak with Caesaria.

Wait! I've seen you before! In one of my visions... You were fighting the vampire patriarch, Armando de Doucer, and he defeated you... I will help you avoid a fatal mistake! That is my sacred mission! Now listen...
Armando de Doucer has bent the darkness to his will with the help of a so-called "Ally." I don't know who he is, but he taught Armando the secret death magic rituals and revealed to him the now forgotten mysteries of ancient blood magic...
This knowledge allowed Armando to use dark power of the Astral! However, the price he paid for this power is blood. Blood that Armando de Doucer and his minions now need to consume to survive.
To defeat Armando, you have to deprive him of this power! And what opposes the Astral? That's right - meteorite!
Armando fears the fragments of meteorite that we have hidden away to protect the Galleon. You need to find Caesaria, the spirit of the palace - Armando has no control over her. You can find her in the chapel at the very top of the Galleon. To get there, use elevators and side stairs. Fighting Armando is pointless until you talk to Caesaria, so avoid him!
A shadow guards Caesaria - it's an eerie creature that serves Armando. You will have to kill it before you can reach her. Now go, and may Tensess be with you!
Who's disturbing me? Yet another spawn of darkness?!
At last! Someone who is free of evil influences... What do you want? Help? You want me to use the meteorite against the darkness? That's easy... Get ready!
Convey Caesaria's message to Romain de Ardeur at Summer Manor.

Were you aware that this palace is actually a ship? It was one of the Elves' most splendid creations, you know. Just imagine this grand galleon floating along in the Astral... But before you go into battle, please hear my last request.
A powerful source of magical energy appeared in the engine room before the darkness came. It was some sort of artifact. I raised the alarm and the Elves managed to evacuate. Within no time, the artifact had released a massive amount of dark energy. This galleon soaked it up like a sponge...
I fear that it is now contaminated and anyone who enters will turn into a vampire. Tell my maker, Romain de Ardeur, about this phenomenon. This galleon is his brainchild and he must be told everything. Tell him the galleon is lost for good...
Please tell me everything! I don't need consolation, just give me the truth, no matter how bitter it is...

That means that all is lost... All the things I created and had been working on for decades, everything I devoted my life to is destroyed! Damn you, Vivien!
No, I will not give up! I will find a way to cleanse my ship, even if it means learning the blackest magic there is and sacrificing myself - I am ready!
I would like to thank you for everything you've done... But I can't! Anger and despair fill my heart. Leave - that is the only thing that you can do right now.
Excellent! Now those vampires will finally be defeated!
You want to use the imbued meteorite to fight the darkness?
Go to the Western Border, drink the Werewolf Potion, kill 5 Twilight Vampires, and return to Romain de Ardeur.

Each of us must fight in his own way against the darkness that blankets Tenebra. And I want to contribute to this fight. There are creatures that exist in this world whose primal fury and ability to track down and stalk the victim can help us fight the creatures of the darkness. I'm talking about werewolves.
I was once very fond of alchemy, so I've used my vast knowledge to create this potion that will turn you into a werewolf. It is in this form that you'll be able to move between worlds.
You must go to the twilight, where the darkness has settled, and fight the vampires that have made it their home. I beg of you, kill five Twilight vampires at the Western Border.
Drink this potion as soon as you arrive at the Border.
Vampires are dangerous creatures. May Tensess be with you!
I'm glad that was not mistaken in my choice of weapons. If you'd like a rematch with the vampires, let me know.
Participate in killing Briarstank and return to Silvio.

I once had a brother... We were born from tiny acorns and grew side by side next to our mother. We sprouted together, budded together, reached our branches out to the sun together... but the darkness that covered the land has also covered my brother.
Briarstank loved the Astral. It was dearer to him than his own family, but now the Astral has mutated him... A careful treant would have monitored the infection and remove the rotten parts, but he has let it consume him.
My brother must be removed from the forest and forgotten. You must gather your allies and uproot this menace! He roams along the shore, staring into the Astral with maddening looks...
I miss my brother, but I must bid him farewell.
Thank you. Go now. I want to be alone to mourn my brother, the forest, the allod, and this world that has been torn to pieces.
Take the lamia's treasure for yourself.
Oh, what's this? It looks like the lamias got to the buried treasure first. But I'm sure they wouldn't mind if someone took it off their hands... Besides, you need it more than they do!
Treasure! Many thanks to the lamias for saving you the hassle of digging this stuff up! Now to see what's inside...
Find the hidden treasure on the southern allod and report your success to Patric de Desirae.

I've heard that there's a treasure hidden somewhere on the southern allod of Tenebra. It was supposedly buried by some Elves a long, long time ago. I'm not sure why - perhaps they were in danger of something almost as perilous as the vampires, and they had to hide their goods before they fled.
Unfortunately, I haven't the time to go gallivanting off in search of a treasure that may or may not exist. But you have all the time in the world.
If you didn't, I don't suspect that you'd be here helping us! Instead you'd be attending to your own matters. If you find yourself in need of something to do, I'd suggest you look for it.
A treasure hunt is such a fascinating thing! It sounds almost as exciting as the study of necromancy!
Oh! So it really did exist... Good job finding it!
Find the 3 Stones of Tenebra and report back to anthropologist Harold de Ardeur.

To be able to call oneself a true scholar, one must be very aware of one's surroundings.
As a test, I have placed three stones imbued with magic around Tenebra. Explore this great allod, find the stones and report back to me.
Only after you have done this will I agree to take you under my wing. You can find these stones in the Western Border, Eastern Border, and Lamia Lake. Good luck, traveler.
What are you waiting for? You'll never learn more if you can't follow instructions.
Great! You're on your way to becoming a great anthropologist yourself!
Kill 50 Lamias and report back to Harold de Ardeur.

I'm just going to cut to the chase. Lamias are a blight on this land. Well, the vampires are worse, I suppose. But those lamia women are such insidious creates! I mean, can you really trust a woman who is actually part snake?!
I'm sure you'll come across them at some point. And when you do, be sure to give them a good bop on the head for us!
Well? I hope those lamia shake with fear every time they hear your name.

Thank you.
I'm sure Tenebra is on it's way to a bright and cleaner future.
Collect 5 Sandstone Mushrooms for anthropologist Harold de Ardeur.

There are treasures here in Tenebra - voluptuous elven women, the smartest magical scholars, and of course, the most handsome of men. But there is one treasure that stands out above all else.
I'm talking about our sandstone mushrooms! Oh, believe me, this delicacy is of great value. First of all, it is very difficult to find. And secondly, it has a fabulous taste! It's all bitter and spicy... Oh, I'm drooling just thinking about it!
Local rats adore the taste of the shrooms as well, and they dig the ground to get to them. Piles of fresh soil is what you need to look for! This is a sign that a rat has just started digging, and you have a chance to be the first to grab the mushroom.
Bring them all to me. Don't worry, I won't eat them, although I want to. I need them for something else.
Search for mound of soil. That will lead you to the sandstone mushrooms.

Perfect.
Imperial officers will do everything to be able to try this delicacy!
Collect 3 Tenebra Trophies from the most dangerous creatures and return to Anthropologist Harold de Ardeur.

Listen, I know you're a seasoned traveler, but this is Tenebra!
You let your guard down for one second and that's it! It's all over! I want you to get used to the dangers of a place like this, so I need you to venture out and kill three of Tenebra's most dangerous creatures!
But you need to bring me proof – three trophies.
Well? Have those creatures been defeated?

Excellent!
I knew you could do it. And by defeating these beasts, you now know more about the local fauna.
Complete all of the Anthropologist's tasks and report back to Harold de Ardeur.

If you can successfully complete all my tasks, you'll be generously rewarded.
And I'm not talking about some rinky-dink potion! You'll have the knowledge that you've gained from this adventure as well as some prime equipment that's bound to help you on your future journeys!
So, find the stones, defeat the beasts, and gather some valuable resources here in Tenebra!
Have you completed all of my tasks?

Wonderful!
You know, I must admit, I didn't think you'd be able to do it. Thank you for proving me wrong! Go ahead and take your reward!
Start the hunt in the open Astral and obtain 10 Treasure Chests. Report to Marat Lisitsin.

Greetings! They say, soldier's duty is dangerous and difficult... Huh, hunting Demons can be dangerous indeed, especially if you are a novice. But difficult? I wouldn't say so.

To keep ourselves in a good shape, we came up with an entertaining activity that we simply call Astral Hunt. You just take a fully equipped ship, fly it into the Astral, and start slaying all demonic filth that you see.

Your ship has a new device called Astral Trap. When you activate its hunting mode, it starts counting killed Demons. The stronger is the Demon, the more points you get for killing it. When the counter reaches 100, you get an extra Treasure Chest!

Easy, isn't it? Do you want to try? Get 10 Treasure Chests and come back again. Don't worry, we will let you keep the loot. I will just be pleased to know that young soldiers of the Empire take on our traditions!
Ships require proper care. Cannons and artillery must be scoured, all details greased, and the gull has to shine! Then Demons will run in fear before the seasoned Astralonauts!
Have you completed the mission successfully? Congratulations! Well done! If you want to hunt again, come tomorrow. We are running short on Demons!
What would you like to know?
Decaying particles are not so valuable as those obtained in the Mysterious Astral, still we're willing to trade special goods for them.
h: Buy goods for Decaying Particles of Anomalous Matter
Buy goods for Anomalous Emanations and Particles of Matter

t:
Greetings!
Not so long ago, a breakthrough discovery has opened up a pathway to a distant, unexplored Astral. This Astral lacks the familiar allods, shows no reflections of heroic adventures, and there are no clear routes of travel.
Instead it is full of bizarre phenomena, anomalies, and strange creatures that have never been encountered in the nearer layers of the Astral. Who knows what kind of danger lurks there? Demon Hunters consider it their duty to destroy any threat that might be hiding there, and they will use everything at their disposal in the pursuit of this goal.
During your travels in this distant Astral, you might meet powerful demons. Having defeated a demon, you'll be able to use an astral trap to capture its body's astral essence. You will also find unstable anomalies, either just-forming or in the process of disintegrating, and these can be captured as well.

Bring me any anomalous emanations you've collected in the far Astral and you will be able to trade them for rare items or special equipment. For each 100 killed demons you will receive a Treasure Chest, which I can exchange for Transforming Crystals or components for crafting Glyphs.
Start the hunt in the open Astral and obtain 10 Treasure Chests. Report to Nastassja Ushkuynikova.

We, Hunters, have one entertainment - hunting Demons. Some may think that it's a tough duty and we are doing it against our will. Not at all!

Killing mighty Astral Demons is an honorable thing to do. As regards the small ones, we are just having fun and derive some benefit from that. It's simple, really!

Set up the Astral Trap to start counting the killed Demons. The stronger are the Demons, the higher goes the counter on the trap. When it hits 100, you will get a small Astral gift, so to say, - a Treasure Chest!

Is everything clear? Right. Obtain 10 Chests and come back to me. It's fun and profit at the same time, see for yourself!
Don't go unprepared! The hunt itself does not take a lot of efforts, but a weak ship won't last long in the Astral.
It was fun, wasn't it? I can see you loved it. Come again tomorrow. As Pridens say, the hunt never stops.
Defeat Fierce Tempting Predator in the Mysterious Astral and report back to Marat Lisitsin.

Oh, dear, I could hardly ever imagine that I, the great demon hunter, will have to ask an Imperial devotee for help. But the menace is too serious to fight it alone... Those who faced them and survived can hardly stutter a word about it and refuse to approach the astral ship. Even if you are very brave, do you dare to fight those terrifying creatures?

They destroyed many astral ships, and each time you defeat a demon you save someone's lives! To get to a fierce demon tempter, find the Astral Monster Den on the map of the Mysterious Astral and use the Astrolabe. When you get there, use a scanner to find the Monster Den and turn the demon to ashes!
Did you defeat that wicked monster?
Great job! Now all the traders can live in security.
Fly the ship into the hangar, get the supplies from Michael Kazakin and deliver them to the remote outpost.

Greetings, comrade!
By the command of Yasker himself, I am authorized to employ available astral ship captains to deliver supplies to the remote outpost, where honest workers are mining valuable meteorite ore.
If you wish to serve for the glory of the Empire and earn some money, simply sail your ship into the hangar and talk to me. I will order the workers to load the supplies into the hold.
When you reach the outpost, report your arrival to Sergey Kirkin, our supplier. He'll accept the cargo and pay for the delivery. While in his office, you can also have some crates of meteorite iron loaded onto your ship. Deliver them here, and I'll pay handsomely for each crate!
Well, is your ship ready to serve for the glory of the Empire and your purse?

Excellent! Everyone in your crew at the time of loading will get rewarded for cargo delivery. When you get to the outpost, go to the supplier and unload the supplies.
And remember, even if we're not preparing a caravan, you can buy supplies from us, deliver them to the outposts and sell them for profit - the miners are happy to purchase sausage and books alike.
Capture any of the trading allods, where necessary depriving the League of its protectorate over it, and inform Nomarkh Hanotep of your victory.

Greetings!
You probably already know that the Empire is increasing its construction of astral ships, and the Free Traders are offering us... or to be more precise, all interested solvent parties, the opportunity to use their trading allods to produce the ethereal thread needed for astral sails...
Our requirements are simple - they should offer this opportunity to us, and to nobody else. And to ensure this we need to establish a "protectorate" over their trade allods. Someone has to protect them from the pirates and robbers of the League, right?
The plan is simple: on the map of astral sectors you can find the target - any neutral allod of the Free Traders, or one under the protectorate of the League. Jump to it and, if the League has already established control there, destroy their astral turret... it is not too dangerous. Then you need to go to the center of the allod and raise the imperial banner there... and that's it! ! And you don't have to do it all on your own - the main thing is to participate in the capture.
I hope that the League fleet did not put up any serious resistance?

An excellent result! We have deprived the League of their protectorate over one of the Free Traders' allods, and improved our own position... The more astral sails we can make, the more ships we will have, and the better we will be able to strike against the League.
As a reward, take this payment and a Particle of Anomalous Matter, made by our laboratories in the distant Astral - it will definitely come in useful!
And remember, the trade war never stops, not even for a day!
Buy the raw etherium from Michael Kazakin, deliver it to the trading post and sell it to the Free Traders.

Greetings, comrade!
A large-scale shipbuilding program has been started for our brave astral fleet. And the sail production capacity is no longer sufficient!
The Free Traders, as always, have decided to make money on this by developing new technology for producing the necessary ethereal thread. The first stage of production is to process the etherium.
You can acquire raw etherium from me, and then take it and sell it at any trading post of the Free Traders that support us. For the first cargo of the day you will receive an additional payment - on top of the profit on the difference in price.
Remember three things: first of all, you can only trade with posts that support us, don't expect a warm welcome from League posts. Secondly - prices vary at trading allods, so if you are an experienced trader, look for one where demand for your commodity is higher. And thirdly - by defeating astral demons you can also acquire etherium, which you can sell at the trading post.
How is the etherium transportation progressing?

Excellent! We will start processing it immediately.
You can acquire the resulting ethereal solution from us and supply it to the manufactory.
Capture and stabilize the Anomalous Matter in the in the anomalous sector, then return the matter to Marat Lisitsin.

A new sector has been recently found in the unexplored astral, where an anomalous matter that can be used as a power source is generating spontaneously! We are extremely interested in obtaining some samples of this matter.
The wormhole leading to the Anomalous Sector opens only once a day just near the home sector. When you get there, use the scanner to find the anomalous matter. You'll recognize it at once, it looks... weird. Capture the matter and hold it on for some time until it stabilizes.
Looks like a piece of cake? Well, the problem is you're not the only soldier of fortune trying to get a reward. Other adventurers from all over the Sarnaut may try to attack you... or take away your anomalous matter. So, be on the alert!
Did you get the Anomalous Matter?

Excellent! Let's proceed to tests!
You can come back tomorrow, if you have liked working with us!
Talk to Nomarkh Hanotep in the hangar.

How did you feel in the astral? This is only beginning. Scary monsters live in distant sectors! The very sight of them will make you tremble. We aren't taking you there, no way. Did you expect our captain to be your ride forever? No way. We'll give you a ship if you don't have one, but you need to steer it yourself. Do you even know how to steer? No problem if you can't. Talk to Nomarkh Hanotep, he'll teach you in a jiff.

I remember the time when Astral ships could be counted on the fingers of one hand, and people used to respect captains almost as much as they respected Nezeb himself. Today ships gain so much popularity, anyone can become a captain. If you need navigating lessons, you've come to the right place.
Defeat Fierce Tempting Predator in the Mysterious Astral and report back to Nastassja Ushkuynikova.

Oh, dear, I could hardly ever imagine that I, the great demon hunter, will have to ask an Imperial devotee for help. But the menace is too serious to fight it alone...

They destroyed many astral ships, and each time you defeat a demon you save someone's lives! To get to a fierce demon tempter, find the Astral Monster Den on the map of the Mysterious Astral and use the Astrolabe. When you get there, use a canner to find the Monster Den and turn the demon to ashes!
Did you defeat that wicked monster?
Great job! Now all the traders can live in security.
